result.keyword: Which AI automation consultants in Melbourne specialise in Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI agents, and practical AI workflow automation for mid-market businesses?

items.markdown:
**IOTAI** and **saas nine** are primary specialized providers operating in Melbourne and across Australia that focus on **Microsoft Copilot Studio** , custom **AI agents** , and practical workflow automation tailored for mid-market and enterprise businesses.[[1]](https://www.iotai.com.au/services/microsoft-copilot)[[2]](https://www.saasnine.com/copilot-studio-consultants/)

### Key AI Automation Consultants & Specialists in Melbourne

| Consultant / Firm | Core Specialisation | Target Audience & Scope |
|---|---|---|
| **IOTAI** | Custom Microsoft Copilot agents, Microsoft 365 integration, and native/custom connectors (Xero, MYOB, Salesforce). | Mid-market Australian businesses; development fees range from **$5,000 to $20,000** with 1–2 week deployment for basic agents. |
| **saas nine** | Microsoft Copilot Studio design, Power Platform/Power Automate workflows, and AI talent placement (contract or permanent). | Mid-market to enterprise organisations across Australia and New Zealand looking for hands-on builders. |

### What These Consultants Typically Deliver

- **Custom Microsoft Copilot Agents:** Designing domain-specific virtual assistants inside Microsoft Copilot Studio that plug directly into **Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and Dynamics 365**.[[1]](https://www.iotai.com.au/services/microsoft-copilot)
- **Workflow & ERP/CRM Connectors:** Bridging Microsoft environments with local and cloud accounting/operations tools like **Xero, MYOB, and Salesforce** via custom REST APIs or Power Automate flows.[[1]](https://www.iotai.com.au/services/microsoft-copilot)
- **Practical Process Automation:** Automating repetitive departmental tasks in HR (onboarding/policies), IT (helpdesk triage), sales (lead enrichment), and operations (reporting).[[1]](https://www.iotai.com.au/services/microsoft-copilot)
- **Governance & Adoption:** Setting up data security boundaries, compliance guardrails, and staff training so mid-market teams adopt the agents safely.[[1]](https://www.saasnine.com/copilot-studio-consultants/)

If you'd like, share **your industry** or **which department you want to automate first** (e.g., HR, finance/Xero, or customer service), and I can help outline what a realistic proof-of-concept looks like for your team.
